title: Mobile Mechanic Job Work Order Form
subtitle: Control mobile diagnosis, vehicle stabilization, repair, testing, and return or tow decision through verified identity, domain-specific observations, evidence, authorization, exception ownership, and accountable closeout.
description: An original, workflow-complete mobile mechanic service job work order for vehicles, systems, components, fluids, tools, supports, and work-zone controls. It connects approved repair scope, service information, and site plan to present conditions, repeatable evidence, decisions, unresolved work, and the receiving party's handoff.
use_case: Use when a qualified mobile mechanic must control authorized mobile mechanic service work from arrival and baseline findings through change approval, service evidence, testing, and handoff.

sections.guidance: Anchor authorization, assigned work, materials, evidence, testing, and handoff to one controlled job record.

sections.title: Mobile Mechanic arrival, site readiness, and controlled work setup
sections.guidance: Verify actual site conditions before beginning and stop when dispatch assumptions no longer hold.

blocks.label: Site, access, exposure, and work-zone controls
items: Vehicle authority, dispatch location, VIN, unit, and requested scope confirmed
Traffic, visibility, weather, terrain, lighting, and escape path assessed
Vehicle parked, braked, chocked, stabilized, and protected from impact
Jack, stands, lift points, cribbing, and ground capacity verified before elevation
Ignition, keys, battery, high voltage, stored pressure, heat, and moving parts controlled
Fuel, oil, coolant, refrigerant, battery, and spill or fire controls available
Service information, torque values, parts, tools, and recall status checked
Customer and bystanders kept outside the controlled work zone
Removed parts, fluids, batteries, tires, and contaminated material controlled
Functional test, leak check, roadworthiness decision, and tow route defined

sections.title: Mobile Mechanic measurements, testing, and release verification
sections.guidance: Connect each claimed result to an actual method, acceptance basis, and traceable observation.

blocks.label: Measurement, adjustment, and test results
blocks.guidance: Use the method applicable to: Diagnostic code or scan value, Voltage, current, resistance, or battery test, Pressure, vacuum, compression, or temperature, Fluid level, leak, or service quantity, Torque, clearance, wear, tread, or brake measurement, Stationary, functional, roadworthiness, or recovery result.

blocks.label: Functional, condition, and handoff verification

Brakes, steering, tires, wheels, lights, and required controls support the decision

sections.title: Mobile Mechanic job work order closeout and accountable handoff
sections.guidance: Close only when outcome, remaining limitation, next action, evidence, and receiving ownership agree.

blocks.label: Final outcome, handoff, and record location
Record boundary and stop condition
blocks.guidance: This mobile mechanic service job work order is an operational record, not a substitute for applicable law, licensing, product labeling, manufacturer instructions, site policy, safety requirements, or professional judgment. Stop affected work, access, application, operation, testing, or release when traffic, vehicle support, lifting, stored energy, high voltage, fuel, fire, weather, spill, repair information, or roadworthiness condition is uncertain. A automotive or fleet safety supervisor must review the exception, authorize the controlling decision, and preserve its evidence before closeout.

blocks.guidance: A signature records accountability for the stated outcome; it does not cure missing evidence or override a stop condition.
